name: quill
title: Quill
description: Fix grammar, rephrase text and copy text from screenshots with Apple Intelligence, fully on-device.
author: giuseppe_lapenta

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Grammar
commands.subtitle: Apple Intelligence
commands.description: Corrects spelling and grammar of the currently selected text, in place.

commands.name: rephrase
commands.title: Rephrase
commands.subtitle: Apple Intelligence
commands.description: Rephrases the currently selected text; press Enter to replace it.

preferences.name: defaultTone
preferences.title: Default Tone
preferences.description: Tone used until you pick one from the action panel; after that, the last tone you picked is used.

commands.name: ocr-screenshot
commands.title: OCR Screenshot
commands.subtitle: Apple Intelligence
commands.description: Select a screen region and copy the text in it to the clipboard.
